articles.title: Building a self-powered, smart warning system to detect local floods
articles.rawDescription: When sudden rainstorms roll across Texas, flooding can erupt in a matter of minutes. articles.title: These tropical trees breathe at night to survive drought
articles.rawDescription: Some tropical trees have evolved a clever way to survive drought by taking in carbon dioxide at night, allowing them to keep their pores closed during the hot daytime and conserve water. Instead, ancient genome duplications followed by millions of years of genetic reshuffling produced strikingly different strategies, from strong CAM to stress-triggered and hybrid forms.
